sources.title: mt5-large: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview mt5-large is a multilingual text-to-text transformer pretrained by google on the mC4 corpus covering 101 languages. The model implements the T5 architecture adapted for cross-lingual transfer, enabling a single model to handle NLP tasks across diverse language pairs without language-specific fine-tuning. sources.title: mt5-large | PromptLayer Models
sources.snippet: MT5-Large is a multilingual variant of the T5 (Text-to-Text Transfer Transformer) model, specifically designed to handle 101 different languages. Pre-trained on the massive mC4 (multilingual C4) dataset, this model represents a significant advancement in multilingual natural language processing.
